en.heroTitle: Smart Construction Powered by Data & AI
en.heroDescription: Unlock intelligent project planning, real-time safety monitoring, and optimized resource management with next-generation AI tools designed for construction companies.
en.subDescription: The construction industry faces complex challenges—from unpredictable timelines to safety risks and resource waste. Our AI-driven solutions help companies modernize operations, reduce uncertainty, and deliver high-performance projects at scale. We combine advanced analytics, automation, and intelligent insights to transform every stage of construction.

services.title: Predictive Project Planning
services.description: Leverage advanced forecasting models to predict timelines, budgets, delays, risks, and workforce requirements long before they occur.

services.title: Resource Optimization
services.description: Optimize equipment usage, automate inventory tracking, and improve workforce planning through intelligent resource allocation.

services.title: Safety Monitoring & Analytics
services.description: Use real-time dashboards, computer vision alerts, and predictive safety models to prevent incidents and ensure full compliance.

en.ctaTitle: Bring Intelligence to Your Construction Projects
en.ctaDescription: Our solutions help you anticipate challenges, eliminate inefficiencies, and build safer, more predictable operations with the help of AI and data-driven automation.

benefits.title: Reduced Project Delays
benefits.description: Detect bottlenecks and forecast risks early to avoid costly overruns and accelerate delivery.

benefits.title: Lower Operational Costs
benefits.description: Improve resource allocation, reduce waste, and eliminate unnecessary downtime with AI insights.

benefits.title: Enhanced Safety
benefits.description: Leverage predictive alerts and automated monitoring systems to keep workers safe and compliant.

solutions.title: AI-Powered Scheduler
solutions.description: A smart planning engine that predicts milestones, identifies risks, and dynamically adjusts timelines for optimal execution.

solutions.title: Safety Intelligence Platform
solutions.description: A comprehensive safety dashboard combining IoT sensors, risk scoring algorithms, and automated alert systems to reduce accidents.

fr.heroTitle: Construction Intelligente grâce à la Data & à l’IA
fr.heroDescription: Déployez une planification prédictive, un suivi sécurité en temps réel et une optimisation intelligente des ressources grâce à des solutions IA dédiées au secteur de la construction.
fr.descriptionTitle: Construire Plus Vite, Plus Sûr et Plus Intelligemment
fr.subDescription: Le secteur de la construction doit faire face à des défis majeurs : retards imprévus, risques sécurité, mauvaise allocation des ressources ou budgets instables. Nos solutions basées sur les données et l’IA aident les entreprises à moderniser leurs opérations, à limiter l’incertitude et à améliorer la qualité de livraison. Nous apportons une intelligence avancée à chaque étape du cycle de construction.
